text: A tape measure shows inches. The big numbers are whole inches.
The little lines between them are parts of an inch.
The longest little line is the half inch. Shorter lines are quarters.
The shortest lines on most tapes are eighths of an inch.
Hook the metal tip on the end of the board and pull the tape straight.
Read the line right where your mark goes.
Mark with a sharp pencil and draw a small V that points at your spot.
